headings: (500 ML) MIMOSA SUBLIME LIQUID HAND AND BODY SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) MIMOSA SUBLIME LIQUID HAND AND BODY SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

Mimosa Sublime | A floral aroma that transports you to a field full of beautiful mimosa flowers. Delicate floral traces, surrounded by an aromatic burst of cardamom and eucalyptus, merge with the colorful essence of mimosa, which shines at the heart of the fragrance, revealing its voluptuousness through powdery and balsamic accords.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, cardamom, eucalyptus.
Heart notes: violet, mimosa.
Base notes: musk, solar notes.
